sources.title: ntily/supra15_amharic_gec_v1g · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The shipped wrapper detects and repairs it; if you call model.generate directly, add the same cap-hit greedy fallback. 51.8M params: limited world knowledge; it corrects surface form rather than rewriting meaning.

sources.title: ntily/supra15_amharic_fineweb2_clm_v1g · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Continued causal-LM pretraining for Amharic (Ge'ez script), 51.8M params. v1g is the continuation of v1f (+15,200 steps, fresh optimizer, cosine decay) and supersedes it as the base model for GEC.
